description: Assemble a global profile for one QCL item in a single call: top-producing countries, the annual trend, and trade flows (top exporters and importers). The elements follow what the item carries: Production (5510) and tonne trade quantities (5610/5910) for an item with Production; for live-animal items, which have none, their Stocks elements and every trade quantity element they carry. ranking_elements names each ranking's elements and units. Supply item_code or item_query; code wins when both are supplied. For a crop traded mostly in processed form, trade_item_code ranks the exporters and importers on that TCL item instead (rice milled equivalent 30 for paddy rice 27), with the elements still picked from the selected item. A query selects a unique normalized exact label, otherwise a unique relevance match; ambiguous queries require an explicit code. Each ranking uses the selected item at each country's own latest year with data, grouped by unit. The trend is returned inline as year/value points. Country-level only (aggregates excluded). QCL is required; unavailable TCL yields a profile without trade, with a notice. When the merged observation set is too large to inline, it spills to a DataCanvas table (canvas_id + table_name) — call faostat_dataframe_describe for its columns, then faostat_dataframe_query for deeper SQL.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID to stage onto, as returned by a prior faostat_query_observations / faostat_commodity_profile call — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Omit to stage onto this session’s canvas, created on the first spill and reused by every later call, so tables staged earlier in the session sit alongside this one.

item_code.description: Exact item code present in QCL; takes precedence over item_query. Obtain it from faostat_resolve_codes with domain QCL and dimension item.

item_query.description: Commodity label or search term (e.g. "Wheat"). A unique normalized exact QCL label wins, with ";" and "," compared as one character ("Peas, dry" selects "Peas; dry"); otherwise the relevance search must match exactly one item. Broad queries such as "maize" or "milk" require item_code. Whitespace-only or "*" names no commodity; a value made only of quotes, parentheses, asterisks, and whitespace, such as "()", fails invalid_query. Supply this or item_code.

top_n.description: Rows in each ranking (top producers, exporters, importers), at most 50 per call.

trade_item_code.description: TCL item code to rank top_exporters and top_importers on instead of the selected item, for a commodity traded mostly in processed form (QCL holds paddy rice 27; its trade sits in 30, rice milled equivalent). The staged TCL rows follow it; producers and the trend stay on the selected item, and the trade elements are still those the selected item selects (5610/5910 for an item with Production). Obtain it from faostat_resolve_codes with domain TCL, dimension item, and a query naming the traded product. Omit to rank trade on the selected item.

year_end.description: Inclusive end year (e.g. 2022) for the rankings, the trend, and the staged rows; each area then ranks at its latest year up to this one.

year_start.description: Inclusive start year (e.g. 1990) for the rankings, the trend, and the staged rows. An area with no data from this year on drops out of the rankings; set it to a ranking's latest year to keep only current rows.

name: faostat_commodity_profile

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID this call staged onto. When spilled it holds table_name — pass both to faostat_dataframe_describe (table_name as name) for the columns and types, then canvas_id to faostat_dataframe_query for SQL. Also present when the merged set fit inline and no table was staged; faostat_dataframe_describe with this canvas_id then lists any tables already staged on it. Absent when the canvas is disabled or staging failed.

effectiveTopN.description: The top_n the call was served at. Present only when top_n was capped.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_item`: No item_code was supplied, and item_query was omitted, whitespace-only, or "*". `invalid_query`: No item_code was supplied, and item_query is made only of quotes, parentheses, asterisks, and whitespace, such as "()" or "**", so no search term is left. `ambiguous_item`: The query matches more than one QCL item without a unique exact label. `no_match`: The query matched no item, or item_code is absent from QCL. `trade_item_not_found`: trade_item_code names no item with rows in TCL. `domain_not_indexed`: The production domain (QCL) is not in the local mirror selection (FAOSTAT_DOMAINS), so there is no production data to profile. `index_not_ready`: The production domain (QCL) is selected, but its mirror is cold — its initial sync has never completed. `invalid_year_range`: year_start is greater than year_end — a self-contradictory range that can never match. The bounds reach the production, trade, and merged canvas-stream queries alike, so every one of them would return nothing. `canvas_not_found`: DataCanvas is enabled and canvas_id does not resolve to a live canvas — unknown, expired, or owned by another tenant. `query_timeout`: The profile's mirror reads (commodity resolution, rankings, trend, staging stream) — time queued behind other calls plus execution — ran past the 45-second per-call ceiling. `pool_closed`: The server was shutting down and closed its mirror read workers while this call was queued or running. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

item_query.description: Supplied query echoed back, or the canonical selected label for code-only calls.

itemsTruncated.description: Always false: successful profiles select one item without truncating selection.

notice.description: States where the observation set went — the canvas table, inline result, staging failure, or disabled canvas — plus unavailable trade data, mixed units, or other partial-result context.

production_trend.description: The annual series of the ranking_elements.top_producers elements — Production, or Stocks for an item without Production rows — for the selected item, summed over countries per year and ordered oldest-first. Aggregated in SQL over the complete filtered match, so it is not affected by the canvas staging cap.

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value — read it alongside value, since a change in coverage moves the total independently of the quantity measured.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Points are grouped by unit, so a year can appear once per unit rather than summing incomparable quantities.

value.description: The selected item’s ranking_elements.top_producers quantity summed across every country reporting that year.

ranking_elements.description: The elements and units behind each ranking, picked from what the selected item carries. Within a ranking, rows are grouped by unit and never summed across units.

top_exporters.description: TCL elements top_exporters ranks: Export quantity 5910 when the selected item has Production, otherwise every export quantity element (5907–5910) — of those, the ones trade_item (or, without it, the selected item) carries. Empty when trade is unavailable or that item carries none of them.

element.description: Element label; null when the element vocabulary has no label for the code.

units.description: Units of the rows the ranking matched for this element within the year bounds; null is an unspecified unit. Empty when no row in the bounds carries the element.

top_importers.description: TCL elements top_importers ranks: Import quantity 5610 when the selected item has Production, otherwise every import quantity element (5607–5610) — of those, the ones trade_item (or, without it, the selected item) carries. Empty when trade is unavailable or that item carries none of them.

element.description: Element label; null when the element vocabulary has no label for the code.

units.description: Units of the rows the ranking matched for this element within the year bounds; null is an unspecified unit. Empty when no row in the bounds carries the element.

top_producers.description: QCL elements top_producers ranks and production_trend sums: Production (5510) when the item has any Production row, otherwise every Stocks element (5111, 5112, 5114) it carries. Empty when it carries none of them.

element.description: Element label; null when the element vocabulary has no label for the code.

units.description: Units of the rows the ranking matched for this element within the year bounds; null is an unspecified unit. Empty when no row in the bounds carries the element.

requestedTopN.description: The top_n the call asked for. Present only when it was above the 50 cap.

resolvedItemCodes.description: Item codes the commodity query resolved to.

resolvedItemMatches.description: Number of selected QCL items; always one for a successful profile.

resolved_items.description: The single selected QCL item and its canonical label: the item top_producers and production_trend read, and top_exporters and top_importers too unless trade_item is present.

spilled.description: True when the merged observation set was staged on a canvas table.

staged_row_count.description: Rows actually staged on the merged canvas table (present when spilled). Equals the 50,000-row cap when truncated.

table_name.description: Canvas table holding the staged observations: the selected item’s QCL rows for the ranking_elements.top_producers elements, plus the TCL rows of trade_item (or, without it, the selected item) for the top_exporters and top_importers elements when trade contributed (present when spilled). The notice names which domains the table holds. Pass it as name to faostat_dataframe_describe for its columns (a domain column tags each row QCL or TCL), then reference it in faostat_dataframe_query SQL.

top_exporters.description: Top exporters of trade_item, or of the selected item without it, by summed export quantity (empty when trade is not indexed or that item carries no export quantity element ranking_elements.top_exporters selects).

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value for the ranking's item and reporting year.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Rows are grouped by unit, so values in different units are never summed together — a country can appear once per unit.

value.description: Export quantity for the ranked item (trade_item, or the selected item) and country in its latest reporting year.

year.description: This country's own latest year with data, computed per country — a country whose series ends earlier still ranks, at its own last reported year; years_behind says how far that trails the ranking.

years_behind.description: The ranking's latest year minus year: 0 when this row is current. The ranking's latest year is the newest year among every row it matched — all countries and units within year_start/year_end — not only the rows returned. A positive value marks a series that stopped earlier, such as a dissolved state or a country that stopped reporting the item; year_start set to the ranking's latest year keeps only current rows.

top_importers.description: Top importers of trade_item, or of the selected item without it, by summed import quantity (empty when trade is not indexed or that item carries no import quantity element ranking_elements.top_importers selects).

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value for the ranking's item and reporting year.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Rows are grouped by unit, so values in different units are never summed together — a country can appear once per unit.

value.description: Import quantity for the ranked item (trade_item, or the selected item) and country in its latest reporting year.

year.description: This country's own latest year with data, computed per country — a country whose series ends earlier still ranks, at its own last reported year; years_behind says how far that trails the ranking.

years_behind.description: The ranking's latest year minus year: 0 when this row is current. The ranking's latest year is the newest year among every row it matched — all countries and units within year_start/year_end — not only the rows returned. A positive value marks a series that stopped earlier, such as a dissolved state or a country that stopped reporting the item; year_start set to the ranking's latest year keeps only current rows.

top_producers.description: Top countries by the summed QCL element in ranking_elements.top_producers — Production, or Stocks (animals held) for live-animal items without Production rows. Countries only.

flags.description: Distinct data-quality flags across the summed observations, comma-separated and sorted — commonly A=Official, B=time-series break, E=Estimated, I=Imputed, M=Missing (value cannot exist), T=Unofficial, X=from an international organization, plus others FAOSTAT defines per domain; treat any unrecognized flag as informational, never assume official. Null when no summed observation carried a flag. More than one flag means the total mixes data qualities.

observations.description: Observations summed into value for the ranking's item and reporting year.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value; null when unspecified. Rows are grouped by unit, so values in different units are never summed together — a country can appear once per unit.

value.description: The ranked QCL element total for the selected item and country in its latest reporting year — Production, or Stocks for an item without Production rows.

year.description: This country's own latest year with data, computed per country — a country whose series ends earlier still ranks, at its own last reported year; years_behind says how far that trails the ranking.

years_behind.description: The ranking's latest year minus year: 0 when this row is current. The ranking's latest year is the newest year among every row it matched — all countries and units within year_start/year_end — not only the rows returned. A positive value marks a series that stopped earlier, such as a dissolved state or a country that stopped reporting the item; year_start set to the ranking's latest year keeps only current rows.

trade_item.description: The TCL item top_exporters, top_importers, and the staged TCL rows read, present when trade_item_code was supplied and TCL is both indexed and index_ready in faostat_list_domains (its initial sync has completed). Absent otherwise: without trade_item_code the trade rankings read the selected item, and while TCL is not indexed or not index_ready they are empty.

code.description: TCL item code, as trade_item_code named it.

name.description: Item label from the shared item vocabulary.

trend_points.description: Total observations aggregated into production_trend. Exact — the aggregation runs over the complete filtered match, not a capped page.

truncated.description: True when the STAGED CANVAS TABLE hit the 50,000-row staging cap and is therefore a PREFIX of the merged observation set — re-query faostat_query_observations partitioned by year to stage the rest. The rankings and production_trend above are SQL aggregates over the complete match and stay exact either way.
